The surname '''Thane''' can refer to the following people:

*[[Berin Thane]] - a man from [[Emond's Field]], brother of Jon and uncle of Lem.
*[[Jaim Thane]] - a boy from the [[Two Rivers]].
*[[Jon Thane]] - the miller in Emond's Field, father of Lem and brother of Berin.
*[[Kari Thane]] - a girl from Emond's Field.
*[[Lem Thane]] - a young man from Emond's Field, eight months younger than [[Rand al'Thor]], eldest son of Jon and nephew of Berin.
*[[Mistress Thane]] - a member of the [[Women's Circle]].
